findings.summary: The timeout regression mutates the helper's module globals instead of passing its timeout explicitly
findings.diagnosis: The test reaches through complete_before_deadlock_guard.__globals__ to replace DEADLOCK_GUARD_SECONDS. That couples the regression to the helper's implementation and makes a simple test input implicit.
findings.evidence: This is the repository's only use of __globals__ in tests; the helper reads DEADLOCK_GUARD_SECONDS at line 184 while the timeout case rewrites that global at lines 265-269.
findings.correction: Give complete_before_deadlock_guard a keyword-only timeout parameter defaulting to DEADLOCK_GUARD_SECONDS and pass timeout=0.01 in the timeout regression. This removes reflective global mutation and keeps the production-shaped calls unchanged.
